name: keypair-gen
description: Generate SSH key pairs (Ed25519 or ECDSA) as sealed outputs

comment.description: Key comment embedded in the public key

command:
set -eu
if [ -z "${MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR:-}" ]; then
  echo 'keypair-gen: MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR is unset' >&2
  exit 1
fi
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR"' EXIT
chmod 700 "$TMPDIR"
ssh-keygen -q -N '' '-t' 'ed25519' -C '//keys/deploy' -f "$TMPDIR/k"
mv "$TMPDIR/k" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PRIVATE"
mv "$TMPDIR/k.pub" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PUBLIC"
chmod 600 "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PRIVATE" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PUBLIC"

set -eu
if [ -z "${MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR:-}" ]; then
  echo 'keypair-gen: MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR is unset' >&2
  exit 1
fi
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR"' EXIT
chmod 700 "$TMPDIR"
ssh-keygen -q -N '' '-t' 'ecdsa' '-b' '384' -C 'o'\''brien@host' -f "$TMPDIR/k"
mv "$TMPDIR/k" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PRIVATE"
mv "$TMPDIR/k.pub" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PUBLIC"
chmod 600 "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PRIVATE" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PUBLIC"

set -eu
if [ -z "${MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR:-}" ]; then
  echo 'keypair-gen: MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR is unset' >&2
  exit 1
fi
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR"' EXIT
chmod 700 "$TMPDIR"
ssh-keygen -q -N '' '-t' 'ecdsa' '-b' '521' -C '//keys/ec521' -f "$TMPDIR/k"
mv "$TMPDIR/k" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PRIVATE"
mv "$TMPDIR/k.pub" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PUBLIC"
chmod 600 "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PRIVATE" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PUBLIC"

set -eu
if [ -z "${MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR:-}" ]; then
  echo 'keypair-gen: MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR is unset' >&2
  exit 1
fi
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR"' EXIT
chmod 700 "$TMPDIR"
ssh-keygen -q -N '' '-t' 'ed25519' -C 'keypair' -f "$TMPDIR/k"
mv "$TMPDIR/k" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PRIVATE"
mv "$TMPDIR/k.pub" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PUBLIC"
chmod 600 "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PRIVATE" "$MU_SEALED_OUT_DIR/PUBLIC"

error: keypair-gen: sealed_outputs is required (must declare PRIVATE and PUBLIC)
keypair-gen: sealed_outputs keys must be exactly #{"PRIVATE" "PUBLIC"} (got #{"PRIVATE"})
keypair-gen: unsupported curve P-192 (want one of P-256,P-384,P-521)
